Workflow.Name: Get unpaid invoices
Workflow.Description: Returns all open invoices that were sent through PayPal and are not fully paid (Sent, Unpaid or Partially paid), with customer, PayPal invoice ID, total, amount paid, amount due, due date and days overdue. Use it to answer who owes money or what is overdue.
